outcome: Evaluate whether Git commits and history can simplify task CLI state management, identify guards for exceedingly rare or cheaply recoverable scenarios, and recommend a robust lower-complexity design for typical framework-agent work

completion.evidence: Reviewed the 4,300-line CLI/store/schema/importer implementation, focused tests, Decision 0018, 17 store-touching commits, and committed task snapshots. Independent reviewer passed doctor sequentially, 29/29 framework-data tests, and git diff --check; parallel read-only doctor/startup reproduced LOCK_BUSY. Disposition: Adopt the typed per-task store, semantic invariants, recordVersion/taskRevision, and atomic record publication; Revise read locking, common-dir lock scope, whole-store mutation digest CAS, orphan-lock recovery, first-shard staging, redundant durability/path checks, linked-detail validation, and importer lifetime; Reject Git as live transactional state because unfinished state is intentionally uncommitted and commits collapse transitions. Use Git for scoped completion audit, conflicts, and targeted restore only.
